properties.displayName: UAV S9 - IMU Spoofing/Fault (Gyro/Accel Stealthy Drift)
properties.description: UAVTelemetry_CL의 VelocityVariance/PosHorizVariance(EKF_STATUS_REPORT)를 사용해 IMU(자이로/가속도계) 완만한 저강도 드리프트 램프를 탐지. S1(GNSS 스푸핑, PosHorizVariance+VelocityVariance z-score 급증 스파이크)과 달리, S9는 짧은 스파이크가 아닌 2시간 윈도우에 걸친 점진적 상승 추세(누적 램프량)를 낮은 절대 임계값 아래에서 탐지해 스텔스 IMU 조작을 식별(다른 탐지 각도로 S1과 중복 회피). MITRE ICS ATT&CK: T0806 / EMB3D 센서변조(스텔스 램프 인젝션)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 2h;
let binSize = 5m;
let minSamples = 6;
let rampThreshold = 0.02;
let capLevel = 0.15;
UAVTelemetry_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where MsgType == "EKF_STATUS_REPORT"
| summarize AvgPosVar = avg(PosHorizVariance), AvgVelVar = avg(VelocityVariance) by UAVId, TimeBin = bin(TimeGenerated, binSize)
| summarize
    (FirstBin, FirstPos, FirstVel) = arg_min(TimeBin, AvgPosVar, AvgVelVar),
    (LastBin, LastPos, LastVel) = arg_max(TimeBin, AvgPosVar, AvgVelVar),
    SampleCount = count(),
    MaxPos = max(AvgPosVar),
    MaxVel = max(AvgVelVar)
    by UAVId
| where SampleCount >= minSamples
| extend PosRamp = LastPos - FirstPos, VelRamp = LastVel - FirstVel
| where PosRamp > rampThreshold and VelRamp > rampThreshold
| where MaxPos < capLevel and MaxVel < capLevel
| extend TriggerReason = strcat('IMU_스텔스_점진드리프트_램프_Pos', tostring(round(PosRamp,4)), '_Vel', tostring(round(VelRamp,4)))
| extend Severity = 'Medium'
| project TimeGenerated = LastBin, UAVId, FirstBin, LastBin, SampleCount, PosRamp, VelRamp, MaxPos, MaxVel, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S9 - IMU Spoofing/Fault (Gyro/Accel Stealthy Drift) - {{UAVId}}
